- tests/test_claude_anthropic_relay.py:180-184 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: test_broker_rejects_client_authorization fails with BrokenPipeError because connection.request attempts to write the request body to the broker socket after Relay._reject has already rejected authorization and closed the connection.
  WHY: In scripts/claude_anthropic_relay.py lines 102-105, Relay._reject sends an HTTP 400 error and sets close_connection = True before reading the request body. When the client in test_broker_rejects_client_authorization sends the payload via sock.sendall(), writing to the closed Unix domain socket raises BrokenPipeError: [Errno 32] broken pipe. This failure causes the tests-hooks-and-orchestrator CI job and the required lint roll-up check in .github/workflows/ci.yml to fail.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_8-flash ===
